selectedPrinciples: Huge typography carries the beat before detail appears.
One restrained texture or photographic field keeps the family nonblank without becoming a collage.
Low density is enforced through single-support-block layouts and aggressive panel avoidance.
Motion is deterministic and reducible to fade or static behavior.
notes: No external media was embedded for this package.
Visual inspiration stayed at the principle level and was not reproduced as branded visual identity.
